install.note: CLI coding agent by Anomaly/Charm. `opencode-ai` on npm is a THIN SHELL PACKAGE (~8KB): the real platform binary ships as npm optionalDependencies (opencode-darwin-arm64, opencode-windows-x64, …) and a postinstall.mjs links the right one. So the npm path fetches the binary from the npm REGISTRY (not GitHub) — on a slow/regional registry it stalls on those optional-dep packages, and a npmmirror registry fixes it. The curl/powershell installer instead downloads the prebuilt binary directly from GitHub Releases to ~/.opencode/bin (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.opencode\bin), which is the cleanest one-shot path but is GitHub-dependent. Windows npm global bin is %APPDATA%\npm\opencode.cmd (npm shim); if `opencode` isn't found after install, restart the shell or check that dir is on PATH.

install_flow.summary: macOS/Linux: curl script → brew → npm(mirror); Windows: scoop → choco → powershell installer → Git Bash curl → npm(mirror)
agent_steps: macOS / Linux: prefer `curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash` (downloads the prebuilt binary to ~/.opencode/bin, no Node needed). On network failure, fall back to `brew install anomalyco/tap/opencode` then npm.

Windows: prefer `scoop install opencode`; without scoop try `choco install opencode`; without either, run the PowerShell installer `irm https://opencode.ai/install | iex` (or, if Git Bash / MSYS2 is present, `curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash` works identically).

npm fallback (all platforms): verify Node >= 18 (`node --version`), then `npm i -g opencode-ai`. If the install stalls or times out fetching the platform optional-dep packages, use the China mirror: `npm i -g opencode-ai --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com --fetch-timeout=600000`.
Verify with `opencode --version`. On Windows if the command isn't found after an npm install, the shim is at %APPDATA%\npm\opencode.cmd — restart the shell so PATH picks it up.

If an earlier npm install timed out, DO NOT immediately retry: a still-running node/postinstall may be writing to the same node_modules and a concurrent retry corrupts it. Let the runner kill the process tree first (handled automatically on timeout), or manually confirm no node/npm process is running before retrying.
tell_user: Which install method was used (curl / scoop / choco / powershell / npm)
On Windows the npm global shim is %APPDATA%\npm\opencode.cmd — restart the shell if `opencode` isn't found

blocked_regions.zh-CN: opencode.ai itself is reachable in mainland China, but the curl/powershell installer downloads the binary from GitHub Releases (api.github.com + github.com/.../releases/download/...), which is unreliable there. Prefer the npm path with the China mirror instead: `npm i -g opencode-ai --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com --fetch-timeout=600000`. The platform binary ships as npm optionalDependencies, which npmmirror mirrors, so the npm mirror path fully avoids GitHub.

first_run.description: On first launch `opencode` opens a TUI. To use your own provider, add an OpenAI-compatible provider block in the config file, or run /login and pick a provider. OpenRouter, Anthropic, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint are supported.

identity_guard.description: OpenCode is Anomaly/Charm's open-source CLI coding agent (github.com/anomalyco/opencode), npm package `opencode-ai`. It is DIFFERENT from: Claude Code (Anthropic, @anthropic-ai/claude-code), Codex CLI (OpenAI, @openai/codex), and the OpenCode *Desktop* GUI app — a separate EchoBird tool. When installing via npm, use the exact package name `opencode-ai`; do not confuse it with the others.
